newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Philippines to supply fuel to Napocor.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippines to supply fuel to Napocor.

text.p: The National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Wednesday it will sign next week a 6.4 billion peso fuel supply contract with Caltex Philippines Inc, a unit of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
Napocor president Guido Delgado told reporters Caltex will supply the power firm with 1.85 billion litres over a two year period.
The fuel will account for 23 percent of Napocor's fuel requirements.
On Tuesday, Napocor signed a 16 billion peso, two-year fuel supply contract with another Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp.
Petron will supply a total of 4.4 billion litres of fuel oil and diesel or 55 percent of Napocor's requirements.
